DeployBot: [ALERT] 1958001229 node-gpu-17 serving-runtime: CUDA error detected: illegal memory access (misaligned address) during model shard reload. tags: severity=high, service=serving-runtime
DeployBot: affected_nodes=[node-gpu-17], suspected_pattern=reload+pagefaults
Alyssa: oncall here. seeing a spike of 500s and some container restarts aligning with the reload window. pulling logs now.
Mike H: grabbing nvml + dmesg from node-gpu-17. starting remote shell. ETA ~2m
Samira: @Alyssa any customer impact yet?
Alyssa: yes, acme-inc sandbox and a couple of internal smoke tests hit 503s and timeouts. not widespread but persistent. no data leakage.
Kevin: I'm routing new inference traffic away from node-gpu-17 to dedicated-pool-b as a quick mitigation. will push routing rule in 30s.
Alyssa: cordoning node-gpu-17 and scaling up pod replicas on healthy nodes. also enabling model-variant fallback to quantized-safe for live traffic.
Alyssa: ```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 31, PID 23456: Illegal memory access at address 0x7fabcde0
[ 1234.567891] kernel: misaligned address in gpu driver context, possible kernel race during memmap update
[ 1234.567892] serving-runtime[23456]: assert failed in kv_cache.cpp: line 412
```
Mike H: captured /var/log/nvidia/gpu-logs.tar.gz and core dump saved to /mnt/crashdumps/serving-core-23456. uploading to artifact store.
Samira: collecting perf + pfn trace, paging stats and OOM scores. can someone trigger a controlled reload to reproduce? prefer a filtered test on node-gpu-18 first.
Kevin: I can run a limited reload against node-gpu-18 with reduced concurrency. will watch for mem errors.
Alyssa: handoff to Mike H for root cause follow-up. I'm staying to coordinate customer comms. @PagerDuty please escalate to infra kernel team if we see kernel backtraces.
PagerDuty: escalation created: incident-1958001234 -> infra-kernel-team. severity set to Sev2.
Mike H: reproduction attempt on node-gpu-18 started. initial runs show no error at low load. increasing to production-like concurrency.
Samira: note: we saw similar misaligned-address patterns in past kernel+driver combo after live paging under heavy KV cache churn. adding that to RCA notes.
Alyssa: mitigation summary so far: 1) route traffic away from node-gpu-17; 2) enable fallback model variant; 3) cordon node; 4) collect artifacts and escalate. impacted customers: acme-inc (latency spikes), internal-e2e (timeouts).
Kevin: if node-gpu-18 reproduces, we'll evict pods and force drivers to unload/reload. may require host reboot. planning rolling reboots if needed.
Mike H: uploaded logs + core dump link: https://artifacts.internal/serving/1958001234/ bundle.tar.gz
Alyssa: customer comm draft: "We're investigating a GPU driver-related error causing intermittent 503s for a subset of requests. We're routing traffic away from affected hosts and will provide updates." sending to outreach in 10m.
SupportBot: reaction :eyes: on draft.
Samira: assigning action items: Mike H -> RCA + kernel backtrace analysis; Kevin -> reproduction + safe reload; Alyssa -> customer comms + ops coordination.
Alyssa: leaving a note for postmortem. setting incident tag: root_cause=potential-kernel-race, mitigations=reroute+fallback+cordon, next_steps=driver-upgrade-or-kernel-patch
Mike H: logging follow-up ticket for driver vendor with attached core and backtrace.
Alyssa: thanks team. I will update when we have repro or vendor guidance. :thumbsup:
